newsitem.title: THAILAND: Suspension on First Asia shares lifted.
newsitem.headline: Suspension on First Asia shares lifted.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) on Tuesday allowed trading to resume in the shares of First Asia Securities Plc which was suspended on Monday.
The SET said in a statement the suspension was lifted after the firm had released information concerning its recent merger with finance and securities firm Securities One.
The company had also informed SET that it planned to delist after the merger, but no date for the delisting was given.
The company told the SET that it had agreed to sell 90 million baht ($3.46 million) of fixed assets to Securities One under the merger.
The assets sale, to be completed by end-February, was part of Securities One's takeover of First Asia that began last year.
